name: Pickleball England
summary: The national governing body for pickleball in England, recognised as such by Sport England in December 2024. A not-for-profit organisation, it selects England teams, runs national competitions and was a 2019 founder member of the World Pickleball Federation.

founded.editorNote: Not verified: pickleballengland.org (loaded 2026-10-25) gives no founding date on its About, Governance or Affiliations pages.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified: no address found on pickleballengland.org; the Contact Us page returned a redirect loop on 2026-10-25.

name: Pickleball Scotland
summary: The national governing body for pickleball in Scotland, a wholly volunteer-run organisation that began in late 2018 and was recognised by sportscotland in December 2024.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified: pickleballscotland.org Contact page gives only an email address, no postal address (checked 2026-10-25).

name: Pickleball Wales
summary: A volunteer-run, not-for-profit body for pickleball in Wales, trading name of Y Ddraig Goch Ltd, which began in March 2024. It says it aims to be recognised as the sport's National Governing Body in Wales.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified: pickleballwales.org Contact page lists enquiry forms only, no address (checked 2026-10-25).

name: Pickleball Ireland
summary: The national governing body for pickleball across the island of Ireland, established in 2014 and constituted as a not-for-profit company in 2021. It supports clubs, coaches and players and runs national tournaments.

founded.text: 2014; founded as a not-for-profit company in 2021

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified: pickleballireland.ie About and Contact pages give no address (checked 2026-10-25).

name: Pickleball Canada
summary: The national body for pickleball in Canada, created in April 2009 as the Canadian National Pickleball Association at a tournament in the Okanagan. It works with provincial and territorial associations and runs the national championships.

founded.text: April 2009, as the Canadian National Pickleball Association
founded.editorNote: The history page says it then became known as the Pickleball Canada Organization; first board appointed May 2010.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified: pickleballcanada.org Contact page gives only an email address and form (checked 2026-10-25).

members.text: Eleven provincial and territorial associations are listed
members.citation: Footer, Provincial and Territorial Associations list
members.editorNote: Listed: Yukon, Quebec, British Columbia, New Brunswick, Alberta, Nova Scotia, Saskatchewan, Prince Edward Island, Manitoba, Newfoundland and Labrador, Ontario. A national body whose members are provincial and territorial associations rather than nations.

nameChange.text: Created in April 2009 as the Canadian National Pickleball Association, which then became known as the Pickleball Canada Organization

name: Pickleball Australia
summary: A national body for pickleball in Australia.

founded.editorNote: Commonly reported as formed in 2020. Not verified: pickleballaus.org could not be loaded on 2026-10-25 (TLS certificate chain could not be verified), and pickleballaustralia.org.au redirects to a parked page.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified: official site could not be loaded on 2026-10-25.

members.editorNote: Search summaries describe state and territory associations as its members. Not verified: official site could not be loaded on 2026-10-25.

name: All India Pickleball Association
summary: An Indian pickleball association, incorporated in December 2008, that runs national tournaments and rankings. In 2025 the Sports Ministry recognised a different body, the Indian Pickleball Association, as the national federation; the AIPA's court challenge to that decision was dismissed by the Delhi High Court in February 2026.

founded.editorNote: Para 5 records AIPA's claim of recognition by the International Federation of Pickleball in 2010.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified: pickleball.in (loaded 2026-10-25) gives no address on its home page.

members.text: 24 state associations and about 10,000 players, as asserted by the AIPA
members.editorNote: A claim made by AIPA in court, not a finding of the court. Not a count of member nations.

name: Indian Pickleball Association
summary: The body recognised by India's Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports as the National Sports Federation for pickleball, by an order of 25 April 2025 that relaxed some Sports Code requirements. The Delhi High Court upheld that recognition in February 2026.

founded.editorNote: Court records give differing accounts: AIPA says IPA was registered on 11 November 2024; IPA says it was incorporated as a Section 8 company by members of the State Pickleball Association, a Gujarat trust registered on 22 August 2019 (Delhi High Court judgment, paras 7 and 17). No official IPA website found on 2026-10-25.

headquarters.citation: Ministry recognition order of 25.04.2025, as reproduced in the judgment (address of the IPA)
headquarters.editorNote: Address on the Ministry's letter: 2nd Floor, Rituraj Chambers, Swastik Society, off C.G. Road, Ahmedabad 380009.

name: Asociación Española de Pickleball
summary: A Spanish not-for-profit sports association for pickleball, founded in 2012 and based in Madrid, which is listed by the European Pickleball Federation as its full member for Spain.

name: Deutscher Pickleball Bund
summary: A German pickleball association founded in Gelsenkirchen on 15 January 2017, which reports more than 150 clubs and is a member of both the Global Pickleball Federation and the World Pickleball Federation. Germany has more than one national pickleball body.

founded.citation: About the DPB e.V., Our mission

headquarters.editorNote: Registered association VR 2360, Gelsenkirchen District Court.

members.text: Over 150 clubs (as stated by the DPB)
members.citation: About the DPB e.V., key figures

name: Deutscher Pickleball Verband
summary: A German pickleball association founded in June 2023 and registered in Cologne, which aims to promote the sport from grassroots to top level. The European Pickleball Federation lists it as its full member for Germany; Germany has more than one national pickleball body.

founded.citation: Der Deutsche Pickleball Verband e.V. stellt sich vor

name: Koninklijke Nederlandse Lawn Tennis Bond
summary: The Dutch tennis federation, which also develops pickleball in the Netherlands through its NLPickleball.nl site, supporting new providers and clubs, training session leaders and teachers, and promoting the sport nationally. The European Pickleball Federation links its Netherlands membership to the KNLTB's pickleball site.

founded.editorNote: Not verified for this record: knltb.nl About page returned a redirect loop on 2026-10-25.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified: knltb.nl could not be loaded on 2026-10-25.

name: European Pickleball Federation
summary: The continental federation for pickleball in Europe, a not-for-profit association based in Luxembourg and created on 31 May 2023 with 25 founding countries. It reported 39 country members in September 2025 and runs European championships, rankings and referee programmes.

name: Asia Federation of Pickleball
summary: A non-profit continental federation for pickleball in Asia, registered in Singapore as a company limited by guarantee. Its bylaws describe it as the Asian continental confederation under the Unified World Pickleball Federation.

founded.editorNote: Not verified: afpickleball.org (loaded 2026-10-25) gives no founding date; its bylaws were updated on 20 September 2025.

members.editorNote: The bylaws list a larger number of Asian countries and territories; the home page figure is the member count stated.

name: World Pickleball Federation
summary: An international federation for pickleball that has unified with the International Pickleball Federation (IPF) and is pursuing recognition within the Olympic Movement. It groups national federations under five continental confederations and is one of more than one body claiming to govern the sport worldwide.

founded.citation: Affiliations page: Pickleball England as 2019 founder members of the WPF
founded.editorNote: Date stated by a founder member, not by the WPF itself; worldpickleball.org gives no founding date. The WPF operates under By-Laws adopted in 2023.

headquarters.editorNote: Reported as moving to Lausanne, Switzerland after the IPF merger. Not verified: worldpickleball.org (loaded 2026-10-25) gives no address.

members.text: 73 federations engaged with the WPF, across five continental confederations
members.editorNote: 'Engaged' is the WPF's own wording; it may not equal full member nations.

name: PPA Tour
summary: The professional pickleball tour run by the Professional Pickleball Association, founded in 2019 by Connor Pardoe and now sponsored as the Carvana PPA Tour. It stages about 20 events a season and in 2024 merged with Major League Pickleball to form the United Pickleball Association.

founded.editorNote: First event held in Mesa, Arizona, in 2020.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified: ppatour.com Contact page gives no address (checked 2026-10-25).

name: Major League Pickleball
summary: A co-ed professional team league for pickleball with 20 teams in 2026, whose matches combine women's, men's and mixed doubles games. In 2024 it merged with the PPA Tour to form the United Pickleball Association.

founded.editorNote: Not verified: majorleaguepickleball.co FAQ (loaded 2026-10-25) gives no founding date; the About page returned 404.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified: no address on majorleaguepickleball.co (checked 2026-10-25).

name: Association of Pickleball Players
summary: A pickleball tour that combines professional and amateur events, running the APP Tour in the United States alongside an Asia tour and collegiate series.

founded.editorNote: Not verified: theapp.global About page (loaded 2026-10-25) gives no founding date.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified: no address on theapp.global (checked 2026-10-25).
